name: LSEG
description: The LSEG Connector provides real-time access to LSEG's comprehensive financial market data ecosystem, spanning across asset classes and domains. It enables seamless integration of institutional-grade market data, analytics, and valuation tools directly into conversational AI workflows, allowing users to access deep market insights, perform complex calculations, and analyze financial instruments through natural language interactions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LSEG to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LSEG to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.analytics.lseg.com/lfa/mcp/server-cl. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LSEG MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LSEG lists 20 MCP tools, including fx_spot_price, fx_forward_price, bond_price, bond_future_price, option_value, ir_swap, interest_rate_curve, credit_curve, inflation_curve, fx_forward_curve, qa_ibes_consensus, and qa_macroeconomic.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LSEG?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LSEG in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
LSEG requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LSEG is developed by LSEG. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
